source: RFC 0007 §6.4; round-2 review R1 and its review
statement: A shadow window's numbers are the sum of one report per instance, each that instance's latest cumulative report: an instance's report replaces only its own. A second report of one instance, a report of another window, a negative count, or no report from an instance seen reporting on the window keeps it open instead of being counted, and one instance's CANDIDATE_ERROR blocks the window by itself.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a window sums one report per instance, and anything else keeps it open
cocache:CoCacheShadowTest#each instance's report has its own key, and one under another's key is not counted
control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#an instance seen reporting on a window must keep reporting until it closes
